topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I couldn’t help but feel a wave of surprise when I saw the image. There it was, my artwork, immortalized on someone’s skin. At first, my mind raced with a mix of emotions. But as I paused and took a deeper look, I saw the care and admiration in every line and curve. It’s not every day that one’s creation is so cherished that it becomes a part of someone’s body. It’s humbling and touching, really. I hope the tattoo has brought them as much joy as creating the original piece brought me. It’s a reminder that art truly connects us in unexpected ways.
